summary: Overview of distributing collections: update galaxy.yml first, choose among Galaxy, Pulp 3 Galaxy, Red Hat Automation Hub and private Automation Hub, and follow four steps from server config to publishing.
questions: Which distribution servers support signed collections?
Can I publish any collection to Red Hat Automation Hub?
What are the main steps to distribute a collection?

answer_card.title: Collection distribution servers
answer_card.answer_md:
Update `galaxy.yml` before distributing.

| Server | Accepts |
|---|---|
| Ansible Galaxy | All collections |
| Pulp 3 Galaxy | All, supports signing |
| Red Hat Automation Hub | Red Hat certified only, supports signing |
| Private Automation Hub | Owner-authorized |

Steps: configure servers, build the tarball, prepare, publish.
